body:
The actual full Agent release quality job has now run and reveals the remaining configured-hook blockers; bd98 fixes the earlier entrypoint/three test lines but does not alone clear these. Complete source: https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/actions/runs/39696993156/job/119572598229 . Please keep correction ownership coordinated here rather than duplicate branches.

Pinned Ruff reports E721 at scripts/legacy_public_urls.py:123; scripts/release_context.py:71; scripts/research_papers.py:107; scripts/wait_for_release_ci.py:53,73,84,87,90,119,120,135,144,147,149,191. Flake8 additionally reports E203 at scripts/validate_homepage.py:50 and E501 at tests/browser/test_out_execute_browser.py:142 (136>120). Existing repaired lines in publication/link tests and binary entrypoint also appear in this old-source failure as expected. Ruff-format, Semgrep, shellcheck and actionlint passed.

Please make only semantics-preserving compatibility changes for the actual pinned hook versions, with targeted negative regressions. In particular exact integer checks must continue rejecting booleans; do not mechanically replace type(value) is int with isinstance(value,int), which would weaken JSON/release validation. Likewise preserve exact schema expectations for other types, homepage byte/range behavior and identical browser JavaScript string content. Do not suppress rules globally or remove fail-closed gates. Run the complete applicable pinned hooks over the final release delta to surface remaining issues together, then bind independent review and fresh required hosted checks to the final head. Main ff452 full release remains blocked; successful runtime evidence is not publication clearance.

Preserve exact-type subclass semantics as well as bool rejection. If the validator deliberately requires exact builtin types, a narrowly documented per-line E721 exception with review/negative tests is preferable to weakening that invariant merely to satisfy a style warning; no global rule disable. For the E203 slice, a named start offset can retain the same range while remaining compatible with both formatter and flake8. Please consolidate the real diagnostics into one reviewed correction rather than repeated partial CI pushes.

Coordinating the full pinned-hook correction requested in #issuecomment-6330353929 on this same repair branch. The local nine-file follow-up retains exact builtin checks with documented per-line E721 exceptions, a fixed field-tuple alias, an identical homepage slice range and identical browser JavaScript bytes. It adds case-specific bool/coercion/subclass refusals; 616 focused regressions pass. All 16 applicable non-installing configured hooks now pass individually over the complete repository, including pinned Black/Ruff/Ruff-format/Flake8, shellcheck/actionlint and the actual Insight ESLint under Node22.17.1. Original intermediate formatting/environment failures are retained; the environment-install hook was not repeated against the shared runtime. Independent semantic review is finishing. No new public source push yet; existing bd98 Windows/offline producers are still allowed to finish and their evidence will remain source-specific. Full hosted release qualification is not waived.

@codex review

Please review exact head29cff7d0ba8df59491eaf881cacb23f3f1725025 / tree9154e21dce81eb59edefb4be722da086138af665, normal parentbd98, unsigned. All nine added raw files were read back byte-identical to the independent freeze. This consolidates the actual full-release pinned-hook diagnostics from comment6330353929 without weakening exact builtin schemas, bool/subclass refusal, complete job inventories or source/attempt binding. Homepage range and browser JS values are preserved. 616 regressions, all16 applicable non-installing configured whole-repository hooks, six production/browser strict files and independent semantic/negative review pass. Nine-path strict test diagnostics and the one independently assessed extra Python-scanner finding remain explicit in the PR. Every originalbd98 producer finished successfully before advancement; no original was cancelled or relabeled. Fresh final-head hosted/full-main/release gates remain required.
